text: For n ≥ -2, a type A is an n-type if and only if:
choices: πₖ(A) is trivial for k > n
all identity types a=b in A are (n-1)-types
A has at most n+3 elements
explanation: The recursive definition: (-2)-types = contractible; (n+1)-types = all identity types a=b are n-types. This gives the h-level hierarchy: contr (-2), prop (-1), set (0), groupoid (1), …
